name: regression/block-absorbs-first-and-zero-hp-kills
source: game: CreatureCmd.Damage (block absorbs the hit first, the unblocked rest is HP loss; CreatureCmd.Kill at 0 HP)
doc: A lone enemy set to 8 HP and 4 block: the first STRIKE_IRONCLAD (6) breaks the block and leaves 6 HP, the second takes it to 0 and kills it. The player's block is set to 5 and pinned at the start, as are the enemy's HP and block.

expect.why: 6 damage into 4 block: the block goes first
the 2 the block did not take are HP loss
the second 6 takes the 6 HP left: 0 HP kills
